a.text: Before the gaze of thousands upon thousands, I am still as a doll.
I go where they want me to go. I make the sounds they want me to make.

steps.name: Lost Girl
steps.text: For two days and two nights, I haven't seen a single soul...

steps.name: Lost Girl
steps.text: Which... which way is Lungmen? Which way is home?

steps.name: Lost Girl
steps.text: Dad, Mom... I'm thirsty... I'm tired...

steps.name: Lost Girl
steps.text: Are those... buildings, afar?

steps.name: Lost Girl
steps.text: I'm almost there... don't fall asleep...
Cut!

steps.name: Director
steps.text: Wonderful, Nyamu! That's exactly the feeling I was going for!

steps.name: Director
steps.text: An ordinary village girl leaves everything behind on a journey to pursue her musical dreams.

steps.name: Director
steps.text: This scene is her darkest moment. After this, a serendipitous encounter sets her on the path to becoming Lungmen's favorite musician.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Appreciate the compliment, D~

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Dunno why, but when I read the script, I found myself really identifying with the heroine.

steps.name: Director
steps.text: Of course! It was tailor-written just for you, Miss Nyamu!

steps.name: Scriptwriter
steps.text: *Shangshu dialect* Yeah right... like we didn't rewrite it in a rush to make the New Year screening...

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Scriptwriter
steps.text: The investors saw the success of The Drummer Girl and demanded we cast you for the lead role.

spans.text: The investors saw the success of
and demanded we cast you for the lead role.

steps.name: Scriptwriter
steps.text: Then your agency wanted the movie out for the New Year screening, so the director here made me rewrite the script in a week...

steps.name: Scriptwriter
steps.text: In the original ending... the girl was meant to have this phantasmagoric dream in her dying moments.

steps.name: Scriptwriter
steps.text: Under a blaze of dazzling lights, an unremarkable girl staggered her way onto the awards podium.

steps.name: Scriptwriter
steps.text: There, in her dream, she finally won everyone's recognition and made peace with everything.

steps.name: Scriptwriter
steps.text: That's what the ending was supposed to be! A savage, ironic satire!

steps.name: Director
steps.text: Ding nei goh fai, you think that trash you wrote would've got funding like this without Nyamu's name value?

spans.text: , you think that trash you wrote would've got funding like this without Nyamu's name value?

steps.name: Scriptwriter
steps.text: Who gives a shake about your funding? You've been kissing sponsors' asses for so long, you've forgotten how to make art!

steps.name: Scriptwriter
steps.text: Stories like this just don't come true! Ordinary people never just get the chance to step into the spotlight!

steps.name: Scriptwriter
steps.text: *Shangshu dialect* You don't know that because you're not from the countryside! Well, I am, and I know!

steps.name: Director
steps.text: I'll show you, third-rate hack writer—
They close the distance, and the war of words turns physical.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Guys, you could talk this out...

steps.name: Scriptwriter
steps.text: I've always wanted to strangle you for those garbage shots of yours, ri ni xian ren ban ban!

spans.text: I've always wanted to strangle you for those garbage shots of yours,
ri ni xian ren ban ban!

steps.name: Director
steps.text: Puk gaai, you just see, you're the first one I kick out the door when I get rich!

spans.text: , you just see, you're the first one I kick out the door when I get rich!

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Hello?? Can you not—?!

steps.name: Assistant
steps.text: Hospital called. Director and scriptwriter got put in the same ward. In facing beds.

steps.name: Assistant
steps.text: Both of them are in neck braces though, so all they do is stare at each other.

steps.name: Assistant
steps.text: Still, this means we can't shoot for a while...

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Well, I haven't had a proper break in a hot minute. I'd say this is a silver lining for me.

steps.name: Assistant
steps.text: We'll contact you once we nail down an upcoming shoot schedule for you. Just be on standby until then.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: (Mutters) Man, I don't know why, but that's a weight off my shoulders...

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: No, no, I can't relax yet—

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Mom...?
The girl picks up her phone, slides the balcony door open and steps outside.

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: Y'eat dinner yet, Nyamu? Y'all busy?

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Sure I ate.

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: Us folks at home been having a great year for wheat. Out'n the fields afore sunup, harvestin' away till sundown.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: What? Y'all don't listen when I tell ya, huh? Take it easy, slow down. Enjoy country livin'.

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: Jus' don't want you to go wearin' yourself too thin, sweetie. Y'get weary out there, come home and take a break.

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: Say, sweetie, whaddya wanna eat for the holidays? Me and Dad'll whip you up somethin'...

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: I ain't makin' it back for the holidays, c'mon! I'm always busiest when everyone else ain't...

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: That so...

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: (Distant voice) Mom, y'got Sis on the phone?

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: (Sound of running)

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: Sis! We saw the trailer for your new movie on TV!

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: Too bad there ain't any theaters around here. We wanna buy your tickets!

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Heheh, hey, no sweat. I'll send y'all a copy when they print the discs!

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: Yay—!

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: You look so cool in the movie, playin' on the drums!

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: I'm startin' to learn drums too. Been usin' your old set to practice.

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: Betcha been gettin' mad crazy at the drums now, right? I wanna perform on stage one day just like you!

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: I... heheh, been a li'l busy lately, ain't had time to practice.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: But I'm no slacker, no way! You'n me, let's knock 'em dead!

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: You bet! Okay, Mom's yellin' at us to go to bed. You sleep soon, Sis!

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Y'all take care a'yerselves! Night!

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: G'night!

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: Miss Nyamu, the agency just received an offer for you from a major variety show.

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: Recording starts tomorrow at 8pm, and it's slated to run into the early morning. Are you available?

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: That's sudden, wouldn't you say...

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: Well... the other guest they're inviting on is Miss Sora. The idol girl.

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: She's about even with you in terms of fanbase, and she's well-regarded both inside and outside the industry.

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: It's a great opportunity for exposure, and I know the schedule's a little tight, but the agency would really love for you to be on the show...

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: Okay, tell them—Nyamu's looking forward to working with them all.

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: Great. That's a wrap for today, then.

steps.name: Voice on the Phone
steps.text: Good night, Miss Nyamu. Sweet dreams.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: (...Well, at least I'm getting sleep tonight.)
She looks up at the digital clock on her coffee table. It reads '00:23'.
She flops hard on the sofa, letting it envelop her as she sinks snugly in.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: How many months since I practiced last...?
Nyamu drags herself out, and over to the electronic drum set. A thin layer of dust has already formed on the cymbals.

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: ...Where'd my sticks go?
She has almost forgotten the last time she held a drum stick.
Was it at home? Or on the set of The Drummer Girl, even longer ago?

spans.text: Was it at home? Or on the set of

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: ...Screw it. See what's on TV, then call it a day.

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: Hello to all my fans! Fresh new talent Nyamu here!

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: I just starred in The Drummer Girl, airing in theaters now! It's a super intriguing movie, and I hope you'll all see it on the big screen!

spans.text: airing in theaters now! It's a super intriguing movie, and I hope you'll all see it on the big screen!

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: My dream's to be the best drummer in Lungmen—no, in all of Terra!

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: Come with Nyamu! Let's be the mes we wanna be~!

steps.name: Nyamu Yūtenji
steps.text: I've gotta leave some things behind sometimes. I'm a pro, that's what that means... I know that.
